sections.overview: Praval Bhasma – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction:
Praval bhasma is a natural rich source of calcium and an Ayurvedic medicine prepared from Coral. It has been used traditionally in Indian Ayurvedic medicine as a supplement in treating various conditions of bone metabolic disorders associated mainly with calcium deficiency. It is also an Ayurvedic treatment for certain other diseases like asthma, cough, bleeding disorders etc. This medicine should only be taken strictly under medical supervision. 
 It maintain balances of Vata, Pitta and Kapha Doshas but especially Kapha and Vata Dosha.
sections.ingredients_of_praval_bhasma:
Purified coral pieces 
 Aloe vera juice extract/Shatavari ( Asparagus racemosus ) root juice extract or Jayanti juice extract or cow milk. 

 Method of Preparation 
 First of all grind purified coral pieces into fine powder which is further ground with aloe vera juice extract/Shatavari ( Asparagus racemosus ) root juice extract or Jayanti juice extract or cow milk. It is finally formed to a flat, disc shaped cakes and then it is dried and subjected to 800 – 900 degree Celsius for about 3 – 4 hours. This process is repeated for three times. Ultimately a white colored Bhasma (Coral calx) is obtained.
sections.therapeutic_uses:
Praval Bhasma has many uses like: 

 For eye disorders and phthisis 
 Chronic respiratory diseases 
 Bleeding disorders such as nasal bleeding, bleeding hemorrhoids, menorrhagia 
 Cough and cold 
 Excessive sweating, night sweating 
 Painful micturition and leucorrhoea 
 Toxic conditions 
 It is useful to improve digestive power, immunity, vision power, and skin complexion.
sections.dosage:
Consume about 250 mg of Bhasma either one or two times a day before or after food or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Traditionally it is administered along with butter, milk, ghee, sugar, candy or honey.
sections.contraindications_side_effects:
This medicine must be taken under strict medical direction. 
 Its self-medication can be unsafe. 
 Over-dosage may result in serious poisonous side effects. 
 It is better to avoid in case of pregnant and lactating mothers and even in children. 
 Have this medicine in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Praval Bhasma – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Rasatarangini 23/129 
 Introduction 
 Praval bhasma is a natural rich source of calcium and an Ayurvedic medicine prepared from Coral. It has been used traditionally in Indian Ayurvedic medicine as a supplement in treating various conditions of bone metabolic disorders associated mainly with calcium deficiency. It is also an Ayurvedic treatment for certain other diseases like asthma, cough, bleeding disorders etc. This medicine should only be taken strictly under medical supervision. 
 It maintain balances of Vata, Pitta and Kapha Doshas but especially Kapha and Vata Dosha. 
 Ingredients of Praval Bhasma 
 
 Purified coral pieces 
 Aloe vera juice extract/Shatavari ( Asparagus racemosus ) root juice extract or Jayanti juice extract or cow milk. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 First of all grind purified coral pieces into fine powder which is further ground with aloe vera juice extract/Shatavari ( Asparagus racemosus ) root juice extract or Jayanti juice extract or cow milk. It is finally formed to a flat, disc shaped cakes and then it is dried and subjected to 800 – 900 degree Celsius for about 3 – 4 hours. This process is repeated for three times. Ultimately a white colored Bhasma (Coral calx) is obtained. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 Praval Bhasma has many uses like: 
 
 For eye disorders and phthisis 
 Chronic respiratory diseases 
 Bleeding disorders such as nasal bleeding, bleeding hemorrhoids, menorrhagia 
 Cough and cold 
 Excessive sweating, night sweating 
 Painful micturition and leucorrhoea 
 Toxic conditions 
 It is useful to improve digestive power, immunity, vision power, and skin complexion. 
 
 Dosage 
 
 Consume about 250 mg of Bhasma either one or two times a day before or after food or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Traditionally it is administered along with butter, milk, ghee, sugar, candy or honey. 
 
 Contraindications/Side Effects 
 
 This medicine must be taken under strict medical direction. 
 Its self-medication can be unsafe. 
 Over-dosage may result in serious poisonous side effects. 
 It is better to avoid in case of pregnant and lactating mothers and even in children. 
 Have this medicine in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
